verdict.rationale: Built-in accessibility warnings are a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions accessibility checks, a11y linting, or development-time accessibility warnings for SolidJS. The only lint-related item is a community question about reactivity-loss warnings, which is a different topic and offers no affirmative support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get built-in accessibility warnings during development instead of relying on separate audit tools
